120	Remember I said that the word "this day" appears here
121	once, and also here: "and HaShem has declared you today."
122	So let's start with the Ramban, who begins by explaining "today":
123	"And HaShem has declared you today" — for this day is for you like the day of
124	Sinai,
125	like the day of Sinai, and HaShem exalted and raised you through receiving
126	the Torah, to be for Him a treasured people from among all peoples, for only
127	you received the Torah.
128	So there is a parallel between these two days: the day of
129	the giving of the Torah at Mount Sinai and this day.
130	I'll try to briefly repeat something we spoke
131	about in the past, in Parashat Bechukotai,
132	and in previous years also here in Parashat Ki Tavo. A very
133	important point.
134	At Mount Sinai,
135	we'll see in a moment the verses describing
136	the scene at Mount Sinai, or what happened before the giving of the Torah,
137	the Holy One, blessed be He, offers us the Torah through
138	Moshe Rabbeinu,
139	and we said "we will do and we will hear," and we meant it.
140	But as is known, 40 days after the giving of the Torah
141	came the sin of the golden calf,
142	and we did not receive the Torah, meaning we did not receive
143	in practice the tablets; they were broken on the seventeenth of Tammuz.
144	Now there were two covenants: there was a covenant sealed
145	at Sinai,
146	and another covenant at the end of the 40 years, in the Plains of Moab.
147	It continues in this Parashah, Parashat Ki Tavo; in fact
148	this is the heart of Parashat Ki Tavo, but since
149	we spoke about it in previous years, I won't repeat
150	it now. The heart of the Parashah is the rebuke,
151	the section of rebuke, right? If you listen to His commandments,
152	it will be this way, and if you don't listen, it will be otherwise. And it is written
153	there at the end:
154	"These are the words of the covenant that HaShem commanded Moshe to make with the children of Israel
155	in the land of Moab, besides the covenant He made with them
156	at Sinai." So there were two covenants, and the question is why two
157	covenants are needed. The answer, as we said: the first covenant
158	was broken.
